name: Asking For Help
overview: Scripture teaches that true help comes from the LORD, the Creator of heaven and earth, as seen in Psalms 121:1-2 where the psalmist lifts his eyes in confident expectation. God’s promise to strengthen, help, and uphold His people is affirmed in Isaiah 41:10, assuring believers that they need not fear or be dismayed. Jesus invites all who are burdened to come to Him for rest (Matthew 11:28) and encourages persistent asking, seeking, and knocking, promising that their needs will be met (Matthew 7:7). This divine help brings comfort and restoration, as Jeremiah 31:16 reminds us that God rewards faithful endurance and will bring His people back from adversity.
